papers.title: Neutrophil extracellular traps as a potential therapeutic target in inflammatory bowel disease: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Wu Y, Huang Y, Fang H, Gu B, Ge H, Xu R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Elevated Neutrophil extracellular traps (NETs) associated biomarkers have been documented in inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) patients and preclinical models, but the therapeutic potential of targeting NETs remains unclear. This systematic review summarizes NETs-associated biomarkers in IBD patients and evaluates NETs-targeted interventions in preclinical models.
METHODS: Following PRISMA guidelines, we searched databases up to November 2025. Clinical and preclinical studies assessing NETs expression and targeted modulation in IBD were included. Standardized mean difference (SMD) and 95% confidence interval (CI) were calculated using random-effects models.
RESULTS: Forty-eight studies (12 clinical, 31 pre-clinical, 5 mixed) were identified. In clinical studies, NETs-associated biomarkers were elevated in the colonic mucosa and blood compared with healthy controls, and higher NETs burden was associated with more severe disease severity and poorer prognosis in IBD patients. In preclinical studies, direct NETs inhibition and degradation reduced disease activity index (SMD = -1.00 and -1.71, P< 0.05) and histological scores (SMD = -1.70 and -2.95, P< 0.01), and reversed colon shortening (P< 0.05). NETs modulation restored epithelial barrier by increasing occludin expression (SMD = 1.35 and 2.59, P< 0.01) and reducing intestinal permeability (P<0.05). Interventions suppressed pro-inflammatory cytokines (IL-1β, IL-6, TNF-α, and IFN-γ; P< 0.05) and increased anti-inflammatory cytokines (TGF-β, IL-10; P< 0.05). Subgroup analyses suggested administration route, modeling methods, and sample types may contribute to heterogeneity, although testing for subgroup differences was limited by the small number of studies. Sensitivity analyses indicated that pooled estimates for most outcomes were relatively stable, although several outcomes were not robust in sensitivity analyses after excluding individual studies. These findings should therefore be interpreted with caution.
CONCLUSION: NETs accumulation is a hallmark pathological feature of IBD. In preclinical IBD models, targeted NETs modulation ameliorates colitis by restoring the intestinal barrier integrity and suppressing inflammatory cascades. Further high-quality preclinical and translational studies are needed to define standardized detection methods, optimal dosing, and delivery strategies for clinical translation.
SYSTEMATIC REVIEW REGISTRATION: https://www.crd.york.ac.uk/PROSPERO, identifier CRD420261365119.

papers.title_zh: 嗜中性球胞外誘捕網作為發炎性腸道疾病潛在治療標的：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）患者及臨床前模型中已記載NETs相關生物標記升高，但標靶NETs的治療潛力仍不明確。本系統性回顧彙整IBD患者NETs相關生物標記，並評估臨床前模型中標靶NETs的介入措施。
方法：依循PRISMA指引，搜尋至2025年11月的資料庫。納入評估IBD中NETs表現及標靶調控的臨床與臨床前研究。使用隨機效應模型計算標準化平均差（SMD）及95%信賴區間。
結果：共納入48篇研究（12篇臨床、31篇臨床前、5篇混合）。臨床研究中，與健康對照相比，大腸黏膜及血液中NETs相關生物標記升高，且較高NETs負荷與IBD患者較嚴重疾病及較差預後相關。臨床前研究中，直接抑制及降解NETs可降低疾病活動指數（SMD = -1.00及-1.71，P<0.05）及組織學分數（SMD = -1.70及-2.95，P<0.01），並逆轉結腸縮短（P<0.05）。調控NETs可透過增加occludin表現（SMD = 1.35及2.59，P<0.01）及降低腸道通透性（P<0.05）來修復上皮屏障。介入措施可抑制促發炎細胞激素（IL-1β、IL-6、TNF-α及IFN-γ；P<0.05）並增加抗發炎細胞激素（TGF-β、IL-10；P<0.05）。次群組分析顯示給藥途徑、造模方法及樣本類型可能造成異質性，惟因研究數量少，次群組差異檢定能力有限。敏感度分析顯示多數結果之統合估計值相對穩定，但部分結果在逐篇排除後並不穩健。這些發現因此應謹慎解讀。
結論：NETs累積是IBD的病理學特徵之一。在臨床前IBD模型中，標靶調控NETs可透過修復腸道屏障完整性及抑制發炎級聯反應來改善結腸炎。未來需要更高品質的臨床前及轉譯研究，以確立標準化偵測方法、最適劑量及臨床轉譯之給藥策略。
系統性回顧註冊：PROSPERO，識別碼CRD420261365119。

papers.title: 16S rRNA Datasets of Gut Microbiota in Stent-Based Diverting Technique and Ileostomy from A Prospective, Open-Label, Multicenter Randomized Controlled Trial
papers.authors: Wu Z, Tong Y, Chen W, Chen W, Li L, Huang D
papers.abstract: Accumulating evidence implicates gut dysbiosis in postoperative complications and delayed intestinal recovery after rectal cancer surgery. Although stent-based diverting technique (SDT) and conventional ileostomy exert divergent impacts on gut microbial balance, high-quality comparative microbiome data from randomized trials are lacking. We report a 16S rRNA amplicon dataset from 80 patients randomized to SDT (n = 37) or ileostomy (n = 43), with fecal samples collected preoperatively and on postoperative day 90. We characterized phylum-level taxonomic composition, α-diversity and intergroup β-diversity across four subgroups, and identified discriminatory taxa via LEfSe. Functional prediction detected differential metabolic pathways after surgery. We additionally performed correlation analyses to link clinical covariates with microbial signatures. This public dataset enables independent reprocessing and cross-study comparisons, facilitating exploration of diversion-strategy-specific microbial remodeling and validation of SDT's gut microbiota-preserving capacity.

papers.title: Irritable bowel syndrome
papers.authors: Chang L, Corsetti M, Chey W, Ford A, Schmulson M, Shin A
papers.abstract: Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is one of the most prevalent disorders of gut-brain interaction, characterized by recurrent abdominal pain or abdominal discomfort associated with altered bowel habits in the absence of identifiable structural disease. IBS affects ~4-11% of the global population and is associated with substantial healthcare utilization, impaired quality of life and considerable socioeconomic burden. IBS is increasingly recognized as a heterogeneous condition caused by dysregulated bidirectional communication within the gut-brain axis. Altered gastrointestinal motility, visceral hypersensitivity, epithelial barrier dysfunction, neuroimmune activation, gut microbiome and metabolome changes, central pain amplification, stress and autonomic dysregulation, and sex-related biological influences underlie pathophysiological mechanisms. IBS can develop after a gastrointestinal infection and can frequently co-occur with other disorders of gut-brain interaction, chronic pain conditions, psychological disorders and organic gastrointestinal disorders such as inflammatory bowel disease and coeliac disease. Diagnosis relies on a positive symptom-based approach using the Rome V criteria, supported by clinical assessment and limited testing to exclude differential diagnoses. Management focuses on improving symptoms and quality of life through an individualized, stepwise approach that involves patient education, dietary interventions, pharmacological therapies and gut-brain behaviour therapies. Emerging biomarkers, multi-omics approaches, digital health tools and precision medicine strategies may enable mechanism-based diagnosis and targeted treatment in the future.

papers.abstract_zh: 大腸激躁症（IBS）是最常見的腸腦互動障礙之一，其特徵為反覆發作的腹痛或腹部不適，合併排便習慣改變，且無可辨識之結構性疾病。IBS影響全球約4-11%的人口，與大量醫療資源使用、生活品質受損及相當的社會經濟負擔有關。IBS日益被認為是一種由腸腦軸內雙向溝通失調所導致的異質性疾病。胃腸動力改變、內臟過敏、上皮屏障功能障礙、神經免疫活化、腸道菌相與代謝體改變、中樞疼痛放大、壓力與自律神經失調，以及性別相關生物學影響，皆為其病理生理機轉的基礎。IBS可能在腸胃道感染後發生，且常與其他腸腦互動障礙、慢性疼痛疾患、心理疾病及器質性胃腸疾病（如發炎性腸病與乳糜瀉）共病。診斷依賴以症狀為基礎的陽性診斷法，採用Rome V準則，並輔以臨床評估與有限的檢查以排除其他鑑別診斷。治療著重於透過個別化、分階段的方式改善症狀與生活品質，內容包括病人衛教、飲食介入、藥物治療及腸腦行為治療。新興的生物標記、多體學（multi-omics）方法、數位健康工具及精準醫學策略，未來可能使基於機轉的診斷與標靶治療成為可能。

papers.title: Mapping the physical topology of the tumor immune microenvironment: macroscopic image fractals as surrogate markers for immune exclusion phenotype and treatment resistance in colorectal cancer liver metastases
papers.authors: Ziyi G, Zhou W, Zou K
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The spatial tumor immune microenvironment (TIME) determines therapy response in colorectal cancer liver metastases (CRLM). To overcome biopsy sampling bias, this study investigates multimodal macroscopic image fractal dynamics to non-invasively map immune physical barriers and metabolic states, constructing a multi-scale immune-radiomics joint score (IRJS) for robust prognostic stratification and exploratory assessment of treatment resistance.
MATERIALS AND METHODS: This dual-center observational study enrolled 270 CRLM patients with dual-modality imaging (contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging, CE-MRI, 18F-fluorodeoxyglucose (FDG) positron emission tomography-computed-tomography, 18F-FDG PET/CT) and digital spatial pathology. Patients were spatiotemporally divided into training (n=150), prospective temporal validation (n=45), and external validation (n=75) cohorts. Structural (FD_MRI) and metabolic (FD_PET) fractal dimensions were combined with the systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) and KRAS status to build the IRJS using XGBoost, utilizing the SHAP framework to evaluate mapping mechanisms.
RESULTS: FD_MRI positively correlated with α-SMA+ pro-fibrotic stromal density (r = 0.684), which may reflect the mechanical barrier excluding CD8+ T cells. FD_PET showed a significant association with core hypoxia (HIF-1α) and systemic immune exhaustion. IRJS robustly identified the immune-inflamed phenotype across training, temporal, and external validation cohorts (AUCs: 0.921, 0.886, 0.862, respectively). The IRJS-identified inflamed phenotype was an independent protective factor for overall survival (HR = 0.31, P < 0.001). Furthermore, IRJS demonstrated significant clinical net reclassification improvement (NRI = 0.384, P < 0.001) and net clinical benefit in decision curve analysis.
CONCLUSION: Dual-modal fractal dynamics provide non-invasive surrogate markers for mechanical constraints and metabolic exhaustion in CRLM. The IRJS model enables robust spatiotemporal assessment of immune evasion, offering multidisciplinary teams a potential framework to explore non-invasive biopsy decisions, prognostic stratification, and provide exploratory insights into potential immunotherapy resistance.

papers.title_zh: 繪製腫瘤免疫微環境的物理拓樸：巨觀影像碎形作為大腸直腸癌肝轉移免疫排除表型與治療抗性的替代標記
papers.abstract_zh:
背景：空間性腫瘤免疫微環境（TIME）決定大腸直腸癌肝轉移（CRLM）的治療反應。為克服切片取樣偏差，本研究探討多模態巨觀影像碎形動態，以非侵入性方式繪製免疫物理屏障與代謝狀態，建構多尺度免疫-放射體學聯合評分（IRJS），用於穩健的預後分層及治療抗性之探索性評估。

材料與方法：此雙中心觀察性研究納入270名具雙模態影像（對比增強磁振造影CE-MRI、18F-FDG正子電腦斷層掃描PET/CT）及數位空間病理學資料的CRLM病人。病人依時空分為訓練組（n=150）、前瞻性時間驗證組（n=45）及外部驗證組（n=75）。結構性（FD_MRI）與代謝性（FD_PET）碎形維度，結合全身免疫發炎指數（SII）與KRAS狀態，使用XGBoost建構IRJS，並利用SHAP框架評估其機制。

結果：FD_MRI與α-SMA陽性促纖維化基質密度呈正相關（r=0.684），此可能反映排除CD8+ T細胞的機械性屏障。FD_PET與核心缺氧（HIF-1α）及全身性免疫耗竭呈顯著相關。IRJS在訓練組、時間驗證組及外部驗證組中皆穩健地辨識出免疫發炎表型（AUC分別為0.921、0.886、0.862）。IRJS所辨識之發炎表型為整體存活的獨立保護因子（HR = 0.31，P < 0.001）。此外，IRJS在臨床淨重新分類改善（NRI = 0.384，P < 0.001）及決策曲線分析中展現顯著臨床淨效益。

結論：雙模態碎形動態為CRLM的機械性限制與代謝耗竭提供非侵入性替代標記。IRJS模型可穩健地進行免疫逃避的時空評估，為多專科團隊提供探索非侵入性切片決策、預後分層，以及潛在免疫治療抗性的探索性框架。

papers.title: Baseline characteristics of participants recruited into the COLO-COHORT study: a UK-wide resource for colorectal cancer prevention
papers.authors: Dunneram Y, Hackney E, Manning S, Louca P, Stewart C, Taylor G
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To describe the design, recruitment, and baseline characteristics of the first phase of COLO-COHORT and to establish this population as a resource for colorectal cancer (CRC) prevention research.
METHODS: COLO-COHORT is a prospective, multicentre observational study recruiting adults undergoing colonoscopy through screening and routine National Health Service referral pathways within a 32-site UK network. We present descriptive data from the first 4754 participants, recruited through 27 Phase 1 sites, including demographics, lifestyle factors, clinical characteristics, biospecimen availability and colonoscopy outcomes.
RESULTS: Participants had a median age of 64 years (IQR 57-70), and 54.3% were male. Overweight (38.0%) and obesity (30.5%) were common, and cardiometabolic comorbidities were prevalent (11.8% with type II diabetes; 39.4% with hypertension). Colorectal neoplasia was identified at colonoscopy in over half of participants (56.1%), with histologically characterised data available on polyp type, size, morphology and anatomical location. Core demographic and clinical variables were available for >95% of participants, with colonoscopy findings recorded for all. Linked blood and stool microbiome biospecimens were available for approximately 80% and 40% of participants, respectively.
CONCLUSION: This paper establishes and characterises COLO-COHORT's Phase 1 study cohort as a well-phenotyped resource, representing a population of individuals undergoing colonoscopy via UK screening and routine clinical pathways. This cohort will support and underpin future collaborative clinical, epidemiological and translational research in CRC prevention.
papers.title_zh: COLO-COHORT 研究納入參與者之基線特徵：英國全國性大腸直腸癌預防資源
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：描述 COLO-COHORT 第一階段的設計、招募情況與基線特徵，並建立此群體作為大腸直腸癌（CRC）預防研究之資源。方法：COLO-COHORT 是一項前瞻性、多中心觀察性研究，透過英國全國 32 個中心網絡，招募因篩檢及常規 NHS 轉診途徑接受大腸鏡檢查的成人。本文呈現首批 4754 名參與者的描述性資料，這些參與者透過第一階段 27 個中心招募，內容包括人口學資料、生活型態因子、臨床特徵、生物標本可取得性及大腸鏡檢查結果。結果：參與者中位年齡為 64 歲（IQR 57-70），54.3% 為男性。體重過重（38.0%）與肥胖（30.5%）常見，心血管代謝共病盛行（11.8% 患第二型糖尿病；39.4% 患高血壓）。超過半數參與者（56.1%）於大腸鏡檢查中發現大腸直腸新生物，並具有息肉類型、大小、形態與解剖位置之組織學詳細資料。超過 95% 的參與者具備核心人口學與臨床變項資料，所有參與者皆有大腸鏡檢查結果紀錄。約 80% 的參與者有連結之血液生物標本，約 40% 有糞便微生物體標本。結論：本文建立並描述 COLO-COHORT 第一階段研究群體，為一個表型完整的資源，代表透過英國篩檢與常規臨床途徑接受大腸鏡檢查之族群。此群體將支持並奠定未來 CRC 預防領域之臨床、流行病學與轉譯研究合作基礎。

papers.title: Patient outcomes and healthcare utilisation following implementation of an advanced therapy care pathway for inflammatory bowel disease: a multicentre, prospective quasi-experimental preimplementation/postimplementation study in the Netherlands
papers.authors: Visser E, Oude Voshaar M, Van Linschoten R, Hoekstra J, Robbers K, de Jonge V
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Care pathways have the potential to decrease treatment variation and improve patient outcomes. This study aims to evaluate the effect of an advanced therapy care pathway (ACP) on patient outcomes, healthcare utilisation and treatment variation among patients with inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) in the Netherlands.
METHODS: A multicentre, prospective quasi-experimental preimplementation/postimplementation study was conducted, with a preimplementation (December 2020-December 2021) and postimplementation period (March 2022-March 2023). Outcomes were collected from electronic medical records and validated questionnaires according to the International Consortium for Health Outcomes Measurement standard set. The effect of the ACP was analysed using difference-in-differences (DiD) analysis.
RESULTS: 1173 patients were included; the majority was female (55%) with a median age of 45 years (IQR 33-58 years). Most patients had Crohn's disease (64%). Patients reported a high level of disease control and this did not change postimplementation (DiD-estimate: 0.12, 95% CI -0.74 to 1.01). Number of emergency room visits and hospital admissions decreased significantly 6 months postimplementation; however, the effect attributable to the ACP was only maintained for admissions (DiD-estimate visits: -0.05, 95% CI -0.10 to 0.01; DiD-estimate admissions: -0.06, 95% CI -0.11 to -0.03).
CONCLUSION: Implementation of an ACP, in which a minimum of care is defined, can achieve outcomes comparable to standard practice, highlighting the value of prioritising structured care pathways, especially given the current burden of IBD on healthcare systems. An ACP can guide healthcare providers and policymakers in standardising treatment and improving quality of care in chronic disease management.
STUDY REGISTRATION: NL8276/NL-OMON21751 (https://onderzoekmetmensen.nl/en/trial/21751).
papers.title_zh: 實施發炎性腸道疾病進階治療照護路徑後之病人結果與醫療資源利用：荷蘭多中心前瞻性準實驗前後期研究
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：照護路徑有潛力減少治療變異性並改善病人結果。本研究目的為評估進階治療照護路徑（ACP）對荷蘭發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）病人之病人結果、醫療資源利用及治療變異性的影響。
方法：進行一項多中心、前瞻性準實驗性前後期研究，分為實施前期（2020年12月至2021年12月）與實施後期（2022年3月至2023年3月）。結果數據取自電子病歷及依據國際健康結果測量聯盟（ICHOM）標準組合所驗證的問卷。ACP的效果以差異中之差異（DiD）分析方法分析。
結果：共納入1173名病人；多數為女性（55%），中位年齡45歲（IQR 33-58歲）。多數病人為克隆氏症（64%）。病人報告的疾病控制程度高，實施後此結果無顯著改變（DiD估計值：0.12，95% CI -0.74至1.01）。急診就診次數與住院次數在實施後6個月顯著下降；然而，僅住院次數的下降效果可歸因於ACP而持續存在（急診就診DiD估計值：-0.05，95% CI -0.10至0.01；住院DiD估計值：-0.06，95% CI -0.11至-0.03）。
結論：實施定義最低照護標準的ACP，可達到與標準照護相當的結果，凸顯了優先推行結構化照護路徑之價值，尤其在目前IBD對醫療系統造成的負擔下更為重要。ACP可引導醫療提供者與政策制定者標準化治療並改善慢性疾病管理之照護品質。

papers.title: Bile acid signaling in health and disease
papers.authors: Fan Z, He M, Liang T, Zhang B, Zhao N, Li P
papers.abstract: Bile acids (BAs), cholesterol-derived amphipathic metabolites which are traditionally regarded as digestive surfactants, are now recognized as pleiotropic signaling molecules that act through ligand-, receptor-, and tissue-specific mechanisms to maintain systemic homeostasis. They exert biological functions via nuclear receptors (FXR, PXR, VDR, CAR) and membrane receptors (TGR5, S1PR2, MRGPRX4). These receptors activate transcriptional and membrane-initiated programs, including FXR-SHP/FGF19 feedback, TGR5-cAMP-PKA signaling, S1PR2-ERK/AKT/RhoA pathways, MRGPRX4-dependent Ca2⁺ signaling, PXR/CAR/VDR-driven detoxification responses, and non-receptor-mediated membrane and mitochondrial stress pathways. This review discusses how the diversity of BA structures, hepatic synthesis, conjugation, transportation, enterohepatic circulation, and microbiota-mediated transformation generates receptor- and tissue-specific signals. Furthermore, we summarize the physiological functions of BA signaling in lipid, glucose, and energy metabolism, intestinal epithelial integrity, mucosal immunity, neuroendocrine regulation, musculoskeletal adaptation, and renal water-salt balance. Additionally, we discuss the effects of disrupted BA signaling on cholestatic and metabolic liver diseases, alcohol-associated liver disease, hepatocellular carcinoma, inflammatory bowel disease, BA diarrhea, colorectal cancer, obesity, type 2 diabetes, atherosclerosis, and biliary tract diseases. Finally, the therapeutic strategies that modulate BA signaling, including the use of FXR and TGR5 agonists, FGF19 analogues, transporter inhibitors, enzyme-targeting methods, microbiota-based treatments, and hydrophilic BA therapies, are evaluated. By categorizing BA biology according to the production of ligands, receptor activation, tissue responses, and disease mechanisms, this review highlights BA signaling as an integrated regulatory network and a tractable therapeutic axis in health and disease.

papers.title_zh: 健康與疾病中的膽酸訊息傳導
papers.abstract_zh: 膽酸（BAs）是源自膽固醇的雙親性代謝物，傳統上被視為消化道界面活性劑，現已被認定為具多效性的訊息分子，透過配體特異性、受體特異性及組織特異性機制維持全身性恆定。它們經由核受體（FXR、PXR、VDR、CAR）及膜受體（TGR5、S1PR2、MRGPRX4）發揮生物功能。這些受體活化轉錄性與膜起始性程式，包括FXR-SHP/FGF19回饋機制、TGR5-cAMP-PKA訊息傳導、S1PR2-ERK/AKT/RhoA路徑、MRGPRX4依賴性Ca2+訊息傳導、PXR/CAR/VDR驅動的解毒反應，以及非受體媒介之膜與粒線體壓力路徑。本綜述討論膽酸結構多樣性、肝臟合成、結合、轉運、腸肝循環及微生物群媒介轉化如何產生受體與組織特異性訊號。此外，我們總結了膽酸訊息傳導在脂質、葡萄糖與能量代謝、腸上皮完整性、黏膜免疫、神經內分泌調節、肌肉骨骼適應及腎臟水鹽平衡中的生理功能。另外，我們討論膽酸訊息傳導失調對膽汁鬱積性與代謝性肝病、酒精性肝病、肝細胞癌、發炎性腸病、膽酸性腹瀉、大腸直腸癌、肥胖、第2型糖尿病、動脈粥狀硬化及膽道疾病的影響。最後，評估調節膽酸訊息傳導的治療策略，包括使用FXR與TGR5促效劑、FGF19類似物、轉運體抑制劑、酵素靶向方法、微生物群為基礎之治療，以及親水性膽酸療法。本綜述依配體產生、受體活化、組織反應及疾病機制分類膽酸生物學，強調膽酸訊息傳導是一個整合性調節網絡，也是健康與疾病中可操作的治療靶點。

papers.title: Propionate promotes CD8+ T-cell infiltration and enhances immunotherapy efficacy in colorectal cancer
papers.authors: Pan J, Tong L, Fei R, Wu K, Ji J, Sun T
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) produced by the gut microbiota are increasingly recognized as regulators of host immunity, yet the role of individual SCFAs in shaping the tumor immune microenvironment in colorectal cancer (CRC) remains poorly defined. This study aims to investigate the role of propionate in antitumor immunity and immunotherapy responsiveness in CRC.
METHODS: SCFA levels, systemic inflammatory cytokine levels, and immune cell subsets were quantified in peripheral blood and tumor tissues from patients with CRC and healthy controls. Syngeneic microsatellite instability-high (MSI-H) and microsatellite stable (MSS) murine CRC models were used to evaluate the therapeutic efficacy of propionate alone and in combination with anti-programmed death-ligand 1 (PD-L1) blockade. CD8+ T-cell infiltration, activation status, and cytotoxic function were assessed by flow cytometry, immunohistochemistry, and single-cell RNA sequencing. Mechanistic investigations included acetylation-dependent protein modification analyses. Molecular analyses of signaling pathways were performed to delineate the regulatory axis underlying propionate-mediated immune modulation.
RESULTS: Propionate levels were inversely associated with systemic inflammation and positively correlated with intratumoral CD8+ T-cell infiltration. Propionate supplementation enhanced CD8+ T-cell cytotoxicity, promoted CD8+ T-cell tumor infiltration and suppressed tumor growth in both MSI-H and MSS mouse models. Notably, propionate significantly potentiated the efficacy of PD-L1 blockade and restored immunotherapy sensitivity in otherwise resistant MSS tumors. Mechanistically, propionate induced acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase 1-dependent acetylation and proteasomal degradation of argininosuccinate synthase 1 (ASS1), resulting in activation of signal transducer and activator of transcription 1 signaling and upregulation of the T cell-recruiting chemokine C-X-C motif chemokine ligand 9. In clinical samples, low ASS1 expression was associated with high CD8+ T-cell infiltration.
CONCLUSIONS: This study revealed the role of propionate in regulating the tumor immune microenvironment in CRC, suggesting propionate as a promising strategy to overcome immune exclusion and enhance the efficacy of immunotherapy.

papers.title_zh: 丙酸促進CD8+ T細胞浸潤並增強大腸直腸癌免疫治療療效
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：腸道菌叢產生的短鏈脂肪酸（SCFAs）日益被認為是宿主免疫的調節者，但個別SCFA在塑造大腸直腸癌（CRC）腫瘤免疫微環境中的角色仍未被充分闡明。本研究旨在探討丙酸在CRC抗腫瘤免疫與免疫治療反應性中的角色。方法：於CRC病人與健康對照者的周邊血液及腫瘤組織中，量化SCFA濃度、全身發炎細胞激素濃度及免疫細胞亞群。使用同基因微衛星不穩定性高（MSI-H）與微衛星穩定（MSS）小鼠CRC模型，評估丙酸單獨使用及與抗PD-L1（程式性死亡配體1）阻斷劑合併使用的治療效果。以流式細胞術、免疫組織化學及單細胞RNA定序評估CD8+ T細胞浸潤、活化狀態及細胞毒殺功能。機制研究包含乙醯化依賴性蛋白質修飾分析。並進行訊號路徑的分子分析，以釐清丙酸介導免疫調節之下游調控軸。結果：丙酸濃度與全身發炎程度呈負相關，與腫瘤內CD8+ T細胞浸潤呈正相關。補充丙酸可增強CD8+ T細胞細胞毒殺功能、促進CD8+ T細胞腫瘤浸潤，並於MSI-H及MSS小鼠模型中皆能抑制腫瘤生長。值得注意的是，丙酸顯著增強PD-L1阻斷劑之療效，並恢復原本具抗藥性之MSS腫瘤對免疫治療的敏感性。機制上，丙酸誘導乙醯輔酶A乙醯轉移酶1依賴性的精胺琥珀酸合成酶1（ASS1）乙醯化與蛋白酶體降解，導致訊號轉導與轉錄活化因子1（STAT1）訊號活化及T細胞招募趨化因子CXCL9上調。在臨床樣本中，低ASS1表現與高CD8+ T細胞浸潤相關。結論：本研究揭示丙酸在調節CRC腫瘤免疫微環境中的角色，顯示丙酸是克服免疫排斥及增強免疫治療療效的具潛力策略。

papers.title: Medical Debt and Advanced Cancer Stage at Diagnosis
papers.authors: Xing J, Han X, Hu X, Meng L, Qu L, Nipp R
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Medical debt affects millions of US residents and has been associated with higher cancer mortality. Whether medical debt burden is associated with incidence of advanced stage cancer, a key determinant of survival, remains unclear.
OBJECTIVE: To examine the association between medical debt and cancer incidence in the US.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This cross-sectional study used ecological county-level data linking 2016 medical debt with age-adjusted incidence rates of 9 cancers from January 1, 2017, to December 31, 2021. The study included 2958 US counties with available data on medical debt in collections and cancer incidence rates. Population-based data were obtained and analyzed from January 11, 2025, to February 15, 2026.
EXPOSURE: Percentage of residents with any medical debt in collections in 2016.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Age-adjusted all-stage and late-stage (regional or distant) cancer incidence rates per 100 000 person-years from 2017 to 2021. Multivariable models adjusted for urban-rural status, Social Vulnerability Index (SVI), primary care physician density, and states were used to estimate differences in age-adjusted incidence rates of cancer associated with county-level medical debt burden.
RESULTS: Among the 2958 US counties included in the analysis, 1154 (39.0%) were urban and 1804 (61.0%) were rural. The mean (SD) prevalence of medical debt in collections was 21.1% (9.6%), with a mean (SD) primary care physician density of 0.54 (0.35) physicians per 1000 population. The prevalence of medical debt ranged from 1.2% to 51.8%. The mean (SD) medical debt prevalence was higher in rural than urban counties (21.5% [10.0%] vs 20.5% [8.9%]; P = .007) and in counties in the highest vs lowest SVI quartile (27.4% [9.0%] vs 13.9% [6.9%]; P < .001). After adjustment, each 10percentage point increase in county-level medical debt was associated with a higher incidence of late-stage lung cancer (5.15 [95% CI, 4.62-5.68] additional cases per 100 000 person-years), colorectal cancer (0.69 [95% CI, 0.44-0.94] additional cases per 100 000 person-years), cervical cancer (0.39 [95% CI, 0.23-0.55] additional cases per 100 000 person-years), melanoma (0.59 [95% CI, 0.48-0.70] additional cases per 100 000 person-years), kidney and renal pelvis cancer (0.38 [95% CI, 0.27-0.49] additional cases per 100 000 person-years), bladder cancer (0.24 [95% CI, 0.16-0.32] additional cases per 100 000 person-years), and head and neck cancer (0.92 [95% CI, 0.77-1.07] additional cases per 100 000 person-years). Similar patterns were observed for overall cancer incidence.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cross-sectional study of US counties, higher medical debt burden was associated with higher incidence rates of late-stage and overall cancer across multiple cancer types. These findings suggest that medical debt may reflect structural and financial barriers associated with cancer diagnosis and outcomes at the population level.

papers.title_zh: 醫療債務與癌症診斷時之晚期分期
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：醫療債務影響數百萬美國居民，且與較高的癌症死亡率有關。醫療債務負擔是否與晚期癌症發生率（存活率的關鍵決定因素）有關，目前仍不清楚。
目的：檢視美國醫療債務與癌症發生率之間的關聯。
設計、場域與參與者：此橫斷面研究使用生態學式（ecological）郡層級資料，將2016年醫療債務與2017年1月1日至2021年12月31日間9種癌症的年齡校正發生率連結。研究納入2958個有醫療債務催收與癌症發生率資料的美國郡。以人口為基礎的資料於2025年1月11日至2026年2月15日間取得並分析。
暴露：2016年有任何醫療債務進入催收程序之居民百分比。
主要結果與測量：2017至2021年每10萬人年之年齡校正全分期與晚期（局部或遠端轉移）癌症發生率。多變項模型校正城鄉狀態、社會脆弱指數（SVI）、基層醫師密度與州別，估計郡層級醫療債務負擔與癌症年齡校正發生率差異之關聯。
結果：在納入分析的2958個美國郡中，1154個（39.0%）為城市郡，1804個（61.0%）為鄉村郡。醫療債務進入催收之平均盛行率（SD）為21.1%（9.6%），平均基層醫師密度（SD）為每千人口0.54（0.35）名醫師。醫療債務盛行率範圍為1.2%至51.8%。鄉村郡的平均醫療債務盛行率高於城市郡（21.5% [10.0%] vs 20.5% [8.9%]；P = .007），SVI最高四分位郡亦高於最低四分位郡（27.4% [9.0%] vs 13.9% [6.9%]；P < .001）。經校正後，郡層級醫療債務每增加10個百分點，與以下晚期癌症發生率增加有關：肺癌（每10萬人年增加5.15例，95% CI 4.62-5.68）、大腸直腸癌（增加0.69例，95% CI 0.44-0.94）、子宮頸癌（增加0.39例，95% CI 0.23-0.55）、黑色素瘤（增加0.59例，95% CI 0.48-0.70）、腎臟與腎盂癌（增加0.38例，95% CI 0.27-0.49）、膀胱癌（增加0.24例，95% CI 0.16-0.32）、以及頭頸癌（增加0.92例，95% CI 0.77-1.07）。整體癌症發生率亦呈現類似型態。

papers.title: S100B in brain-gut-liver crosstalk: from glial activation to multiorgan inflammation
papers.authors: Liu Q, Ming Y, Ji C, Fu L, Li R, Yang Z
papers.abstract: S100 calcium-binding protein B (S100B) is conventionally viewed as a marker of astrocytic injury, blood-brain barrier (BBB) disruption, and neurological disorders. Emerging evidence places S100B within the broader brain-gut-liver axis of inflammatory signaling. This review proposes that S100B is a glial-derived integrating effector that couples enteric glial activation, barrier dysfunction, hepatic fibrosis, and hepatic encephalopathy (HE) into a multi-organ inflammatory network. Its spatial expression map, release kinetics, alarmin (damage-associated molecular pattern, DAMP) activity, and immune-cell infiltration differ among the gut, liver, and brain, shaping axis signaling. S100B is predominantly expressed in astrocytes of the central nervous system, Schwann cells, and enteric glial cells and is also detected in liver tumor immune cells, biliary epithelial cells, and activated hepatic stellate cell (HSC)-associated lesions. It exerts context-dependent functions: at low, nanomolar concentrations it supports neurotrophic activity and barrier integrity, whereas sustained elevation acts as a DAMP that amplifies inflammatory responses through receptor for advanced glycation end products (RAGE), Toll-like receptor 2 (TLR2)/Toll-like receptor 4 (TLR4), nuclear factor kappa B (NF-κB), NOD-, LRR-, and pyrin domain-containing protein 3 (NLRP3) and a disintegrin and metalloproteinase 10 (ADAM10)/β-catenin pathways. Clinically, S100B kinetics, a rapid release with a short half-life after acute injury versus chronic multi-organ spillover in cirrhosis, determines whether elevation reflects a local glial event or systemic disease burden. S100B has been implicated in enteric infectious enteritis, inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), diarrhea-predominant irritable bowel syndrome (IBS-D), cholestatic fibrosis, metabolic dysfunction-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD), alcohol-associated liver disease (ALD), viral hepatitis, hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), and HE with comorbid neuroinflammation. Available evidence suggests that S100B is a candidate link between glial responses, barrier dysfunction, hepatic inflammation, and neuroinflammation within the brain-gut-liver axis, although its causal role, tissue origin, and clinical utility require further validation.
papers.title_zh: S100B在腦-腸-肝交互作用中的角色：從神經膠質活化到多器官炎症
papers.abstract_zh: S100鈣結合蛋白B（S100B）傳統上被視為星狀細胞損傷、血腦屏障（BBB）破壞及神經系統疾病的標記物。新興證據顯示S100B在更廣泛的腦-腸-肝炎症訊號軸中扮演角色。本綜述提出S100B是一種神經膠質衍生的整合效應因子，將腸道神經膠質活化、屏障功能障礙、肝纖維化與肝性腦病（HE）耦合成一個多器官炎症網絡。其空間表現圖譜、釋放動力學、警報素（損傷相關分子模式，DAMP）活性及免疫細胞浸潤在腸道、肝臟與大腦間有所差異，形塑了此軸的訊號傳遞。S100B主要表現於中樞神經系統星狀細胞、許旺細胞及腸道神經膠質細胞，亦可在肝腫瘤免疫細胞、膽管上皮細胞及活化的肝星狀細胞（HSC）相關病灶中偵測到。它具有情境依賴性功能：在低奈摩爾濃度下支持神經營養活性及屏障完整性，而持續升高則作為DAMP通過晚期糖化終產物受體（RAGE）、類鐸受體2（TLR2）/類鐸受體4（TLR4）、核因子kappa B（NF-κB）、NOD-、LRR-及pyrin結構域containing protein 3（NLRP3）以及disintegrin and metalloproteinase 10（ADAM10）/β-catenin路徑放大炎症反應。臨床上，S100B的動力學——急性損傷後快速釋放且半衰期短，相對於肝硬化中慢性多器官溢漏——決定了升高反映的是局部神經膠質事件還是全身性疾病負擔。S100B已被牽連於腸道感染性腸炎、炎症性腸病（IBD）、腹瀉型腸躁症（IBS-D）、膽汁鬱積性纖維化、代謝功能障礙相關脂肪性肝病（MASLD）、酒精性肝病（ALD）、病毒性肝炎、肝細胞癌（HCC）及合併神經炎症的HE。現有證據顯示S100B是腦-腸-肝軸內神經膠質反應、屏障功能障礙、肝臟炎症與神經炎症之間的候選連結因子，但其因果角色、組織來源及臨床實用性仍需進一步驗證。

papers.title: From IL-23/IL-17 to GM-CSF: how is the immuno-inflammatory continuum reshaped in spondyloarthritis?
papers.authors: Jia J, Xie W, Zhou J, Wu W, Zhou S
papers.abstract: Spondyloarthritis (SpA) encompasses axial SpA/ankylosing spondylitis, psoriatic arthritis, reactive arthritis, and inflammatory bowel disease-associated arthritis, unified by entheseal inflammation, extra-musculoskeletal manifestations, and a strong but atypical genetic signature. Although SpA lacks the highly specific autoantibodies and immune-complex pathology typical of prototypic autoimmune rheumatic diseases, adaptive immune participation is evident, positioning SpA along an immuno-inflammatory continuum bridging autoimmunity and autoinflammation. The IL-23/IL-17 axis has provided a powerful framework linking barrier perturbation and tissue stress to neutrophil-rich inflammation and to therapeutic efficacy of cytokine blockade. However, IL-17 is increasingly best viewed as an "ecosystem" output generated by multiple lymphocyte lineages, including innate-like cells, under tissue-specific constraints, with partial uncoupling from continuous IL-23 dependence in selected sites and disease stages. These features expose the limits of a linear IL-23/IL-17 model and help explain therapeutic heterogeneity and the imperfect coupling between inflammation control and osteoproliferative outcomes. In parallel, granulocyte-macrophage colony-stimulating factor (GM-CSF) is emerging as a myeloid amplifier that links lymphocyte activation to durable monocyte and macrophage effector programs, reinforcing cytokine redundancy, including TNF and IL-1 family circuits, and promoting inflammatory "lock-in". We propose a "stage × tissue" model in which early IL-23/IL-17 licensing transitions toward a GM-CSF-licensed, IL-17-dominant, partially IL-23-uncoupled, myeloid lock-in phase. We also discuss biomarker strategies integrating cytokine-module readouts with imaging to support precision trials.
papers.title_zh: 從 IL-23/IL-17 到 GM-CSF：脊椎關節炎中免疫發炎連續譜的重塑機制
papers.abstract_zh: 脊椎關節炎（SpA）涵蓋中軸型脊椎關節炎/僵直性脊椎炎、乾癬性關節炎、反應性關節炎，以及發炎性腸道疾病相關關節炎，這些疾病以附著點發炎、肌肉骨骼外表現，以及強烈但非典型的基因特徵為共同特點。雖然 SpA 缺乏典型自體免疫風濕病常見的高度特異性自體抗體與免疫複合體病理，但適應性免疫的參與仍然明顯，使 SpA 位於連接自體免疫與自體發炎的免疫發炎連續譜上。IL-23/IL-17 軸提供了一個強大的框架，將屏障擾動與組織壓力與嗜中性球豐富的發炎反應以及細胞激素阻斷的治療效果連結起來。然而，IL-17 越來越被認為是由多種淋巴球譜系（包括類先天性細胞）在組織特異性限制下所產生的「生態系統」輸出，在特定部位與疾病階段與持續性 IL-23 依賴性部分解偶合。這些特徵揭露了線性 IL-23/IL-17 模型的局限性，並有助於解釋治療異質性以及發炎控制與骨增生結果之間不完美的耦合。與此同時，顆粒球巨噬細胞群落刺激因子（GM-CSF）正逐漸被視為一種骨髓放大器，將淋巴球活化與持久的單核球及巨噬細胞效應程式連結起來，強化細胞激素冗餘性（包括 TNF 與 IL-1 家族迴路），並促進發炎的「鎖定」。我們提出一個「階段 × 組織」模型，其中早期 IL-23/IL-17 啟動（licensing）過渡到 GM-CSF 啟動、IL-17 主導、部分與 IL-23 解偶合的骨髓鎖定階段。我們也討論了整合細胞激素模組讀數與影像學的生物標記策略，以支持精準試驗。

papers.title: CT Colonography: Where Are We with Colorectal Cancer Screening?
papers.journal_full: Radiographics : a review publication of the Radiological Society of North America, Inc
papers.authors: Taya M, Pickhardt P, Lee M, Kim D
papers.abstract: CT colonography (CTC) is a validated screening test for detection and prevention of colorectal cancer (CRC). In the United States, screening CTC has been covered for Medicare beneficiaries since 2025, elevating it to equal status with other reimbursed CRC screening tests and ending a 15-year policy stalemate. Screening CTC is a highly accurate examination with an immaculate safety record and equivalent sensitivity to colonoscopy for clinically significant polyps. Long-term observational CTC cohorts confirm safety for established polyp size thresholds in terms of test positivity and screening and surveillance intervals. Excellent technique with cathartic bowel preparation, stool tagging, and colonic distention is necessary for high-quality imaging and interpretation, particularly in detection of flat sessile serrated lesions (SSLs). Large SSLs and adenomatous polyps are the most relevant benign precursor lesions to CRC and are the main target of a primary prevention screening strategy. Only CTC and colonoscopy are sufficiently accurate for primary prevention, whereas stool-based and recently approved blood-based tests are limited to detection of cancer in a shorter screening window. CTC allows for selective polypectomy by risk-stratifying large polyps for removal, surveilling small polyps, and ignoring diminutive lesions. CTC is more efficient at identifying advanced neoplasia compared with a universal polypectomy strategy of colonoscopy only, which removes more pseudodisease and incurs excess risk of colonic perforation without benefit. Despite abundant evidence supporting CTC as an ideal screening test, it suffers from widespread and worsening underutilization due to barriers affecting radiology practice and physician support. Opportunistic screening and national trends in the CRC screening landscape will impact future uptake of CTC.

papers.title_zh: 電腦斷層大腸鏡檢查：大腸直腸癌篩檢目前進展為何？
papers.abstract_zh: 電腦斷層大腸鏡檢查（CTC）是一項經過驗證、可用於偵測與預防大腸直腸癌（CRC）的篩檢工具。在美國，自2025年起Medicare已將篩檢型CTC納入給付，使其與其他已獲給付的CRC篩檢項目具有同等地位，結束長達15年的政策僵局。篩檢型CTC是一項高度準確的檢查，安全紀錄完美，對於具臨床意義息肉的敏感度與大腸鏡相當。長期觀察型CTC世代研究證實，依既定息肉大小閾值進行判讀，在檢查陽性率以及篩檢與監測間隔上均屬安全。優良的檢查技術——包括瀉劑腸道準備、糞便標記與大腸擴張——對於高品質影像擷取與判讀是必要的，在偵測扁平無蒂鋸齒狀病灶（SSLs）時尤其重要。大型SSL與腺瘤性息肉是CRC最相關的良性前驅病灶，也是初級預防篩檢策略的主要標靶。目前只有CTC與大腸鏡的準確度足以用於初級預防，而糞便檢測與近期核准的血液檢測則僅限於在較短篩檢窗口內偵測癌症。CTC可透過風險分層選擇性切除大型息肉、監測小型息肉、忽略微小病灶，實現選擇性息肉切除策略。相較於單純大腸鏡的全面息肉切除策略（會移除更多偽疾病並增加腸道穿孔風險卻無額外效益），CTC在辨識進階腫瘤方面更有效率。儘管有豐富證據支持CTC是理想的篩檢工具，但因放射科臨床作業與醫師支持度等障礙，其使用率長期偏低且持續惡化。機會性篩檢與CRC篩檢全國趨勢，將影響CTC未來的採用程度。

papers.title: Beyond the Monolayer: Leveraging 3D Culture Systems to Decode Mechanisms of Drug Resistance and Therapeutic Vulnerabilities in Colorectal Cancer
papers.abstract: Two-dimensional (2D) monolayer cultures remain the workhorse of colorectal cancer (CRC) research and high-throughput screening (HTS), yet they poorly recapitulate tissue architecture, extracellular matrix (ECM) cues, metabolic gradients, and multicellular heterogeneity that govern drug response in vivo. Over the past decade, three-dimensional (3D) culture systems-including spheroids, patient-derived organoids (PDOs), tissue-originated spheroids (CTOS), and collagen-embedded models-have revealed striking 2D vs. 3D discordance in proliferation, signaling, epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT), plasticity, and sensitivity to standard chemo- and targeted therapies. This review synthesizes how 3D CRC models are used to decode mechanisms of primary and acquired resistance to anti-CRC therapies, from metabolic phenotypes and ECM remodeling to EMT, polarity loss, and rare invasive trajectories identified by imaging and quantification of morphologic features of CRC cells grown in 3D. Parallel advances in PDO-based functional precision oncology demonstrate that organoid drug screens can prospectively predict patient response in advanced CRC, while 3D combination screens uncover format-specific synergies that are invisible in 2D. Building on this foundation, we highlight recent technical innovations and discuss how integrating morphometric, metabolic, and trajectory-level readouts can move CRC drug discovery "beyond live/dead." Rather than propose a single best model, we outline practical guidelines for matching 3D platform choice (cell lines vs. PDO/CTOS, collagen vs. Matrigel, static vs. live-imaging HTS) to mechanistic questions and therapeutic goals in CRC. We propose an integrated roadmap-matrix-embedded 3D cultures, high-content morphological endpoints, trajectory analytics, and rigorous HTS validation-to decode resistance mechanisms and prioritize clinically actionable combinations in CRC.

papers.title_zh: 超越單層培養：運用3D培養系統解析大腸直腸癌藥物抗性機制與治療脆弱性
papers.abstract_zh: 二維（2D）單層培養仍是大腸直腸癌（CRC）研究與高通量篩選（HTS）的主力工具，但其無法良好重現體內組織結構、細胞外基質（ECM）訊號、代謝梯度與多細胞異質性，而這些因素主導了藥物反應。過去十年間，三維（3D）培養系統——包括球體（spheroids）、病人來源類器官（PDOs）、組織來源球體（CTOS）與膠原蛋白包埋模型——已揭示2D與3D在增生、訊號傳遞、上皮間質轉化（EMT）、可塑性，以及對標準化療與標靶治療敏感性上的顯著差異。本綜述整理3D CRC模型如何被用於解析抗CRC治療之原發性與後天性抗藥機制，涵蓋代謝表現型、ECM重塑、EMT、極性喪失，以及透過影像與形態特徵量化所辨識出的罕見侵襲路徑。同時，以PDO為基礎的功能性精準腫瘤學研究顯示，類器官藥物篩選可前瞻性預測晚期CRC病人之治療反應，而3D組合藥物篩選則可發現僅存於3D、在2D中無法觀察到的協同效應。在此基礎上，本文強調近期技術創新，並討論如何整合形態計量、代謝與軌跡層級的讀數，使CRC藥物開發「超越存活/死亡」的二元判讀。本文並未主張單一最佳模型，而是提出實務準則，協助研究者依據機制問題與治療目標，選擇適合的3D平台（細胞株 vs. PDO/CTOS、膠原蛋白 vs. Matrigel、靜態 vs. 即時影像HTS）。我們提出一個整合性路線圖——基質包埋3D培養、高內涵形態學終點、軌跡分析，以及嚴謹的HTS驗證——以解析抗藥機制並優先排序具臨床可行性的治療組合。

papers.title: Iron, Biofilm, and Colorectal Cancer: Mechanistic Insights Into Enterococcus faecalis Pathogenesis
papers.journal_full: APMIS : acta pathologica, microbiologica, et immunologica Scandinavica
papers.authors: Luthuli S, Scarpulla N, Bertolino L, Luthuli L, Durante-Mangoni E
papers.abstract: Enterococcus faecalis is a commensal of the human gastrointestinal microbiota that has emerged as a successful opportunistic pathogen associated with persistent infections, antimicrobial resistance, and biofilm formation. Increasing evidence indicates that iron availability functions as a master environmental signal coordinating E. faecalis pathogenic traits. This review summarizes clinical, molecular, and sequencing-based studies linking iron homeostasis to extracellular DNA (eDNA) dynamics, biofilm architecture, virulence regulation, and immune evasion, and critically evaluates the emerging but still associative evidence connecting E. faecalis to colorectal carcinogenesis. We highlight how iron sensing and uptake systems modulate biofilm stability through eDNA release, metabolic cooperation, and transcriptional control via the ferric uptake regulator (Fur) and other regulatory networks. We further integrate experimental findings that suggest how these mechanisms may promote inflammation-driven tumorigenesis in the colon, although a complete causal pathway has not yet been established. Finally, we discuss translational implications, including iron-targeting and eDNA-disruptive strategies as promising anti-virulence approaches, and identify key knowledge gaps requiring future investigation. This review positions iron metabolism at the center of E. faecalis pathogenicity and underscores its potential as a therapeutic target, while recognizing the need for further mechanistic and clinical validation.

papers.abstract_zh: 糞腸球菌（Enterococcus faecalis）是人類腸胃道微生菌叢中的共生菌，已逐漸成為與持續性感染、抗微生物抗藥性及生物膜形成相關的成功伺機性病原體。越來越多證據顯示，鐵的可利用性是協調糞腸球菌致病特徵的主要環境訊號。本綜述總結了臨床、分子及定序相關研究，說明鐵恆定與胞外DNA（eDNA）動態、生物膜結構、毒力調控及免疫逃避之間的連結，並批判性評估糞腸球菌與大腸直腸癌致癌過程之間新興但仍屬相關性（associative）的證據。我們強調鐵感測與攝取系統如何透過eDNA釋放、代謝合作，以及經由鐵攝取調控蛋白（Fur）與其他調控網路的轉錄控制，來調節生物膜穩定性。我們進一步整合實驗發現，提示這些機轉可能如何促進發炎驅動的結腸腫瘤形成，惟完整的因果路徑尚未建立。最後，我們討論轉譯意涵，包括以鐵為標的及破壞eDNA的策略作為有前景的抗毒力方法，並指出未來研究所需的關鍵知識缺口。本綜述將鐵代謝定位於糞腸球菌致病性的核心，並強調其作為治療標的之潛力，同時承認仍需更多機制性與臨床驗證。

papers.title: Targeting CDK9 in Autoimmune Diseases: A New Approach to Inflammation Control
papers.journal_full: Iranian journal of allergy, asthma, and immunology
papers.authors: Raufi H, Zahmatkesh P, Bahadori A, Ahmadi M
papers.abstract: Cyclin-dependent kinase 9 (CDK9), the kinase associated with positive transcription elongation factor b (P-TEFb), enhances transcription elongation by phosphorylating RNA polymerase II and transcription elongation factors. The critical function of P-TEFb is in mediating networks of transcription that are induced by cytokines. More specifically, P-TEFb is involved in STAT3 signaling induced by IL-6 and TNF-inducible NF-κB activation. Within these signaling cascades, the pathways become hyperactivated due to abnormal CDK9 activity, which in turn increases inflammation and causes tissue damage. Pharmacological research has recently made great strides, and new CDK9 inhibitors are being considered as potential treatment options for regulating abnormal inflammatory responses. The efficacy of these inhibitors in reducing inflammation and symptom severity has been demonstrated in preclinical studies of inflammatory diseases, including psoriasis, inflammatory bowel disease, rheumatoid arthritis, and atherosclerosis. The advancement of next-generation CDK9 inhibitors with improved selectivity and diminished off-target effects provides considerable promise for the treatment of many inflammatory disorders.
